scope: read-only WidgetKit Gallery/ATX investigation; no app reinstall, uninstall, erase, or service restart

changedJudgment.previousClaim: AX evidence was interpreted as Gallery search exposing no Heyta provider row.
newObservation: ios/widget-gallery-idb-heyta-after-election.png visibly contains the blue h icon and provider row labelled heyta.
ios/widget-gallery-idb-heyta-query-after-refresh.png shows the same heyta provider row after the prior chronod/SpringBoard refresh.
The matching AX JSON exposes the search field, clear/close controls, and keyboard but omits the visible provider row; this is an AX projection/focus limitation, not proof that the row is absent.
The screenshot therefore proves that Gallery search can present Heyta on this simulator; the earlier no-result conclusion is withdrawn.
changedJudgment.remainingGap: No evidence was taken here that tapping the visible provider row and adding a widget completes successfully.

observed: plutil -p contains four descriptor records with extensionBundleId=com.heyta.WidgetExtension and kinds HeytaTodayWidget, HeytaQuadrantWidget, HeytaHabitsWidget, HeytaFocusWidget.
The cache contains a container record with containerBundleId=com.heyta; hasAccessoryWidgetFamiliesOnly=false and hasHomeScreenWidgetFamiliesOnly=false.
The cache also contains Apple providers, so this is an active ATX descriptor cache rather than an empty/uninitialized index.
Descriptors has three com.heyta.WidgetExtension rows, all reloadRequired=0, descriptorType 0/2/1; descriptor blobs contain the four Heyta kinds and extension/container identifiers.
No pending reload row was present for the Heyta bundle.

metadataChecks.source: HeytaWidgetBundle.swift declares @main and all four Widget types; source Info.plist supplies the standard WidgetKit extension point. No missing Gallery-specific key was found.
metadataChecks.hostVisibility: simctl listapps reports com.heyta as ApplicationType=User, IsDeveloperApp=1, IsFirstParty=0, IsHidden=0, IsRemovable=1, CFBundleDisplayName=heyta.

providerControl.meaning: This simulator has no installed third-party WidgetKit provider to serve as a behavioral control. Apple providers (including Safari and Reminders) are registered, but they do not isolate a third-party-vs-Apple Gallery policy.
